## Game and change type
Game or studio-wide; exploration / decision / handover / delivery / feedback resolution.

## Problem and resulting behavior
What changes for the player or studio user? Include scope and exclusions.

## Design and evidence
Requirement IDs, decisions, affected assets/levels, references, checks actually performed, and unresolved questions.

## Approval request
For a handover: packet path/version, candidate commit SHA, requirement scope, exclusions, and requested owner decision. Drafts are not implementation authorization. Owner approval comment format is in `studio/HANDOVER-PROTOCOL.md`.

## Checkpoint
Updated STATUS with next action and related PRs. Any local-only files, inaccessible assets, or pending cross-repository update?
